newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mobilcom shares surge at opening at 95 dmk.
newsitem.headline: Mobilcom shares surge at opening at 95 dmk.

text.p: The newly issued shares in German mobile phone service provider Mobilcom AG were officially quoted at 95 marks ($55.65) on Monday, surging from their issue price of 62.50 marks per share.
Mobilcom shares are trading as part of the German bourse's new Neue Markt growth stock market -- which provides a platform for innovative young firms to raise capital on the market.
The shares had already been traded in the so-called grey market in a range of 82-84 marks after an issue which the firm said was 100 times oversubscribed.
On the grey market, investors may place orders with brokers ahead of time that are completed once shares officially begin.
